title: The high shelf
starting_code:
# A rare book sits on a high shelf.
# Stand in line with it, cast fendra, and pick it up.
hints: Walk left until you are in line with the book.
Cast the spell *fendra* using your wand to draw the book to your tile.
Once the book is on your tile, you must use `pick_up` before walking on.
intro: There is a rare book on that high shelf, far out of reach. It is the perfect time to try your new spell.
outro: A lovely bit of magic! The books seem quite happy to fly into your hands.
learned: Now you know how *fendra* draws a thing to you, and that it is picked up after.
